41132e2c:  ;
 ;$$$ROUTINE: Builds the ^ACRO global for building and displaying a large list of
 ;events to key health care providers at a facility.
 ;
 ;Functional Description:
 ;1. Input the location and date range for events.
 ;2. Processes all providers with scheduled events within that date range.
 ;3. Populates the ^ACRO global with event details.
 ;4. Then an option file prints or displays the list from ^ACRO.
 ;See also: DGPSOP2
